settings.heading: LOOMING EQUALITY: EMPOWERING WOMEN TO LEAD AND SUCCEED

settings.text:
Our rugs are a Commemoration of craftmanship delivered by our skilled women artisans who play a vital role in their communities. We Vigorously work with cooperatives which are led by women and independent artisans, ensuring them with fair wages, ensuring safe working environments, and the support they need to thrive.

Our Vision for Empowerment: We as a company believe in "Looming Equality" to take action for women to rise, grow, succeed and redefine leadership on their own terms to this world. We believe that women when given an opportunity to lead, spur innovation, build stronger communities, and contribute in development of a more inclusive future for everyone.

Key Areas of Focus:

  • Leadership Development: We strive towards providing all the tools, mentorship, skills, and the support which makes it easy for them to step into leadership roles. Our working environment and leadership training programs enhances the decision making quality which helps them to get a confidence boost.
  • Workplace Equality: Getting equal pay, support, and opportunities are the fundamental rights of each and every women. We have been constantly enhancing our internal policies to promote gender equality and women empowerment at every level of our company. We are dedicated towards establishing a fair and empowering work environment for everyone, from flexible work schedule to equal participation in senior leadership.

settings.title: THREADS OF EMPOWERMENT
settings.text: In order to give women craftsmen in Rajasthan, India, economic opportunity, we assisted in the establishment of a rug-making facility that is solely for them. These days, women make all of the Oushaks and Wool Jute Kilims that are so popular.

settings.title: EMPOWER, LEAD, SUCCEED
settings.text: We support removing obstacles that prevent women from entering the workforce. We are fostering a more inclusive atmosphere that enables women to lead with confidence and realise their full potential by implementing programs that support education, equitable compensation, and leadership positions.

settings.title: THREADS OF EQUALITY
settings.text: The foundation of our business is our dedication to gender equality. We are contributing to the creation of a world where all women have the opportunity to lead, achieve success, and leave a lasting impact by supporting women in leadership roles and encouraging an inclusive culture.
